'''Reduced Tool Battery Consumption''' is an [[Odyssey Engineering]] suit modification that reduces the battery energy used by personal tools by '''50%'''. It occupies one modification slot on the receiving suit.

== Effect ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Attribute
! Modifier
|-
| Tool energy drain
| -50%
|}

The reduction applies while using:

* the EnergyLink in transfer and overload modes;
* the Profile Analyser;
* the Maverick suit's Arc Cutter;
* the Artemis suit's Genetic Sampler.<ref name="wiki">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Reduced_Tool_Battery_Consumption Elite Dangerous Wiki: Reduced Tool Battery Consumption], accessed 14 September 2026.</ref>

It does not reduce the suit's normal background drain or the energy used by shields, life support, [[Night Vision]], the flashlight, or environmental protection. The modification therefore extends working time only when tool use is a significant part of the battery load.

== Compatibility and providers ==

Reduced Tool Battery Consumption can be installed on Artemis, [[Dominator Suit|Dominator]], or Maverick suits with an open modification slot. It is provided by:

* [[Domino Green]] in the core systems;
* [[Wellington Beck]] in the core systems;
* [[Rosa Dayette]] in [[Colonia]].<ref name="inara-rosa">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/37/ INARA: Rosa Dayette], accessed 14 September 2026.</ref>

The modification has the same effect regardless of which Engineer installs it. Choose a provider by unlock progress, travel distance, and the other modifications needed for the same suit.

== Cost ==

The current recipe is:

* 5 Reactor Output Reviews;
* 3 Electrical Fuses;
* 5 Micro Transformers;
* 8 [[Electrical Wiring]];
* 500,000 CR.<ref name="inara-rosa" />

The cost is paid once when the modification is installed. Odyssey suit modifications do not progress through Grades 1–5, but the suit must have a free modification slot. Installed modifications cannot be removed or replaced, so plan the complete suit before committing the materials.

== Selection guidance ==

Reduced Tool Battery Consumption is most useful on builds that operate tools repeatedly away from a recharge point:

* a Maverick suit used for cutting panels, restoring settlements, salvage, and repeated EnergyLink overloads;
* an Artemis suit used for long exobiology sessions with the Genetic Sampler;
* a covert or utility build that relies heavily on the Profile Analyser.

It offers little benefit to a combat-focused Dominator suit when tools are used only occasionally. It also does not offset the energy drain from shields or Night Vision.

[[Improved Battery Capacity]] increases the energy available to every suit system, while Reduced Tool Battery Consumption targets only tool use. Improved Battery Capacity is broader; Reduced Tool Battery Consumption can be stronger during sustained tool operation. Both can be installed together when the role justifies using two slots.
